name: The Given Years
pitch: Name a day and someone you love: every year after it goes to them, and until it comes, blows take seasons instead of health, and each season lost makes you hit harder.
channel: art hit, health paid in seasons

new.name: The Set Day
new.effect: Once a life, name a kin and a day at most ten years off. Your age jumps to that distance from your cap, theirs falls by half the years given, never below 16. Your cap can never rise again.
new.second_home: any life-ending vow, such as a sect's last defender

new.name: Paid in Seasons
new.effect: Health you lose is restored at the defeat check and burns 1 season per 20 % of maximum health. At 0 seasons you are Down, having acted in that instant.
new.second_home: a guardian bound to a fixed term

new.name: Lit Wick
new.effect: Each pulse of a fight burns a season, whether or not you are struck.

new.name: Short Wick
new.effect: +5 points for each season of lifespan under 40.
new.second_home: any old cultivator, any Last Radiance life

new.name: Given Years
new.effect: +2 points per 1 % of your realm's lifespan given away, while the person named lives, in any fight. Two grades: this one on art and basic; The Herd-Child holds a companion grade, +1.5 per 1 % on L2, to +45. One size would change fights.
new.second_home: any build with a sworn sacrifice; any bond that can take years, such as capability #3's treasure; used by The Herd-Child

new.name: Nothing to Lose
new.effect: +10 points for each doubling of the enemy's years left over your own, to +100.

new.name: Evening Table
new.effect: Longevity theme, Earth, outer, sealed by event: sit a last season with someone whose lifespan is ending. Size 8. Notables Short Wick and Nothing to Lose; keystone The Set Day as the capability.

new.name: Keeping-House Sutra
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Fire and Earth. Four household arts, all paid in linh lực.

new.name: Last Harvest
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 4.2, cost 0.25, 2 s, guarded on own seasons 14 or fewer.

new.name: Kin tie
new.effect: A named person bound by marriage, blood or adoption, beside Quests' master and disciple ties.

questions: Do you want a family system at all, and how thin can it be? The Kin tie is the smallest version.
'You won and you died' is this build's natural ending. Should a result type say so?
May a gift of age go below a floor of 16, and is 0.5 the right rate?
